description: This file defines the 'Functions' class within the 'Complex' namespace, providing a collection of static methods for complex number mathematical operations such as trigonometric, inverse trigonometric, hyperbolic, inverse hyperbolic functions, and other complex number manipulations.

classes.name: Functions
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for complex number operations such as trigonometric, inverse functions, hyperbolic functions, and other manipulations.

methods.name: abs
methods.description: Returns the absolute value (modulus) of a complex number, equivalent to rho().

methods.name: acos
methods.description: Returns the inverse cosine of a complex number.

methods.name: acosh
methods.description: Returns the inverse hyperbolic cosine of a complex number.

methods.name: acot
methods.description: Returns the inverse cotangent of a complex number.

methods.name: acoth
methods.description: Returns the inverse hyperbolic cotangent of a complex number.

methods.name: acsc
methods.description: Returns the inverse cosecant of a complex number.

methods.name: acsch
methods.description: Returns the inverse hyperbolic cosecant of a complex number.

methods.name: argument
methods.description: Returns the argument (theta) of a complex number.

methods.name: asec
methods.description: Returns the inverse secant of a complex number.

methods.name: asech
methods.description: Returns the inverse hyperbolic secant of a complex number.

methods.name: asin
methods.description: Returns the inverse sine of a complex number.

methods.name: asinh
methods.description: Returns the inverse hyperbolic sine of a complex number.

methods.name: atan
methods.description: Returns the inverse tangent of a complex number.

methods.name: atanh
methods.description: Returns the inverse hyperbolic tangent of a complex number.

methods.name: conjugate
methods.description: Returns the conjugate of a complex number.

methods.name: cos
methods.description: Returns the cosine of a complex number.

methods.name: cosh
methods.description: Returns the hyperbolic cosine of a complex number.

methods.name: cot
methods.description: Returns the cotangent of a complex number.

methods.name: coth
methods.description: Returns the hyperbolic cotangent of a complex number.

methods.name: csc
methods.description: Returns the cosecant of a complex number.

methods.name: csch
methods.description: Returns the hyperbolic cosecant of a complex number.

methods.name: exp
methods.description: Returns the exponential of a complex number.

methods.name: inverse
methods.description: Returns the multiplicative inverse of a complex number.

methods.name: ln
methods.description: Returns the natural logarithm of a complex number.

methods.name: log2
methods.description: Returns the base-2 logarithm of a complex number.

methods.name: log10
methods.description: Returns the base-10 logarithm of a complex number.

methods.name: negative
methods.description: Returns the negation of a complex number.

methods.name: pow
methods.description: Raises a complex number to a real power.

methods.name: rho
methods.description: Calculates the rho (magnitude) of a complex number.

methods.name: sec
methods.description: Returns the secant of a complex number.

methods.name: sech
methods.description: Returns the hyperbolic secant of a complex number.

methods.name: sin
methods.description: Returns the sine of a complex number.

methods.name: sinh
methods.description: Returns the hyperbolic sine of a complex number.

methods.name: sqrt
methods.description: Returns the square root of a complex number.

methods.name: tan
methods.description: Returns the tangent of a complex number.

methods.name: tanh
methods.description: Returns the hyperbolic tangent of a complex number.

methods.name: theta
methods.description: Calculates the theta (argument) of a complex number.
